survey.architecture: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs, built on top of Starlette. It provides HTTP and WebSocket routing, automatic validation and serialization using Pydantic, dependency injection, security schemes, OpenAPI documentation generation, and background task handling. FastAPI applications are ASGI applications that route incoming requests to handler functions, resolving their dependencies and validating request parameters before execution.

boundaries.note: FastAPI extends Starlette with routing decorators and OpenAPI generation. Users extend FastAPI by subclassing or using include_router() to compose APIRouter instances

survey.architecture: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs in Python. It extends Starlette (an ASGI framework) with a sophisticated dependency injection system, automatic OpenAPI documentation generation, and request/response validation using Pydantic. FastAPI routes HTTP and WebSocket requests through a request handler that resolves dependencies, validates inputs against annotated parameters, executes the endpoint function, serializes the response, and returns it to the client. The framework bridges raw ASGI with developer-friendly decorators and type annotations.

survey.architecture: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance Python web framework for building APIs with automatic documentation and validation. It is built on top of Starlette (ASGI web framework) and Pydantic (data validation library), and runs on ASGI servers. The framework's core responsibility is to route incoming HTTP and WebSocket requests to user-defined endpoint functions, automatically validate request data using Pydantic models, serialize responses, and generate interactive API documentation (Swagger UI, ReDoc). At its center are the `FastAPI` application class and `APIRouter` routing engine, which orchestrate dependency injection, request/response handling, security, middleware, and OpenAPI schema generation.

entry_points.what_it_starts: The main application instance that receives ASGI scope/receive/send and routes requests to path operations
Registration of HTTP routes with automatic dependency injection and validation

core_abstractions.role: Route definition that wraps endpoint functions with automatic parameter extraction, validation, dependency resolution, and response serialization
Model representing a function's dependencies and parameters, used for recursive dependency resolution
Base class for parameter descriptors (Query, Path, Header, Cookie, Body) that control request data extraction
FastAPI's exception class for returning HTTP error responses
Main application class extending Starlette that manages routes, middleware, exception handlers, and OpenAPI generation

steps.what_happens: ASGI app entry point receives scope/receive/send from server
Creates handler function for matched route that extracts and validates all dependencies
Recursively resolves all dependencies, validates request data, executes generators/context managers
Executes the actual endpoint function with resolved dependencies
Encodes response using jsonable_encoder and returns Response object
Collects all registered routes and generates OpenAPI schema
Builds OpenAPI specification dictionary from routes and dependencies
Renders Swagger UI documentation page at /docs
Decorator method that accepts route path and response configuration
Creates APIRoute instance and adds to application routes
Analyzes endpoint function signature to extract parameters and dependencies
Recursively analyzes function to build dependency tree

boundaries.note: Extends Starlette to add FastAPI-specific features; users subclass or instance-configure it
Can be subclassed to customize request handling and response serialization
Pydantic v2 compatibility layer providing Pydantic model introspection
Wraps Starlette's ASGI app handler for request/response pattern
Base class for security schemes; users can create custom security implementations
Validates all incoming request data against Pydantic models before endpoint execution
Catches validation errors and returns safe HTTP 422 responses without internal details

survey.testing_posture: FastAPI has a comprehensive test suite with 504 test files covering routing, dependencies, security, exception handling, OpenAPI generation, and request/response validation. Tests are located in test directories throughout the repository and use the TestClient from fastapi/testclient.py for integration testing.

docs.what_it_covers: Documentation appears to be maintained in a separate directory (not enumerated in source files); 358 doc files suggest comprehensive guides covering first steps, request bodies, responses, dependencies, security, middleware, background tasks, and deployment
